targets.authors: Rainero I, Rubino E, Gallone S, et al.
targets.title: Cluster headache is associated with the alcohol dehydrogenase 4 (ADH4) gene
targets.evidence_quote: The single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) rs1126671 located in exon 7 of the ADH4 gene was associated with an increased risk for CH in two Italian studies, whereas rs1800759 located in the promoter region of ADH4 could only be associated with CH in the smaller case–control study. Thus, we performed a replication study on the ADH4 SNPs rs1126671 and rs1800759 in a large, Swedish case–control cohort in order to further investigate the possible contribution of ADH4 to CH.
targets.outcome_quote: The data did not support an association of the ADH4 SNPs rs1126671 and rs1800759 with CH.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors report no association for either variant, contrary to the associations reported by both cited Italian studies.
